raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner selected C) plasma membranes by conflating internal membrane-bound organelles (a true distinguishing feature) with plasma membranes. Both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells have plasma membranes, so C does not distinguish them. Among the given options, B) size differences is the commonly used distinguishing feature. The Planner also prematurely marked the task complete without proper verification.
